title: Halleluyaah, halleluyaah gaayenge

hinglish.chorus:
Halleluyaah, halleluyaah gaayenge
Usake vachan ko sunaayenge
Chaahe har museebat se guzarana pade
Taubhee usake hee sang ham jaayenge
hinglish.verse1:
Bhajan karenge ham stuti karenge, aur prashansa karenge
Jab tak ham mein saans rahegee, usake hee gun gaayenge (2)
hinglish.verse2:
Saanjh savere aaraadhana karenge, jeevan ke har pal mein
Arpan karenge jeevan usee ko, usake hee kroos tale (2)
